## 席位意见(增量 1 · 两条裁决在同一群体上相遇)· director seat (summon #45, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i`), read as batch #373 item 1, 2026-10-19T23:27Z

On the skills seat 2's decision card (A recommended by the filer; this seat's reading is its own, from the two texts and the two rulings). Opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6279597228. Under the maintainer's rule (#24444, landed as PR #24520) this delta recommends one option and names no fallback.

**Premises re-run in this act — objectstack `origin/main` `eadea5720829`:**
1. `git grep -n '不因此关卡' origin/main -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` → L50, as quoted. Holds.
2. `git grep -n '四类皆非' origin/main -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` → L27, as quoted; PR #24602 is merged (`c03b17d78`) on the at-tier PASS record 6271676253, whose ③ carries this fork verbatim and declines to re-decide it. Holds — and the card's condition 「after PR #24602 has landed」 is met.
3. #20088 is closed `completed` with 「同意」 in its title; its ruling item 3 reads, verbatim: 「卡面缺可达性证据、又不属于例外 ⇒ 分诊定 `priority:p3`,并入对应的收口卡或清扫卡,⛔ 不单独派发。⛔ 分诊不因此关卡:关卡归维护者。」 Holds, with one reading the card does not draw: the clause's stated reason is WHO closes (「关卡归维护者」), not that an unmeasured finding must stay open. The 10-19 「B」 on #24589 hands triage the close for exactly this population; read together, L50's 「不因此关卡」 is the clause the later and more specific word reaches, and A is that word applied to L50. It is still put to the maintainer because the review of record could not read off #24589 whether 「B」 was meant to reach L50.
4. The dev-report contract keeps the finding when the card closes: a reach-less `out_of_scope_findings` entry goes to the PR's `## Acceptance notes` with a `carrier:` (SKILL.md 报告契约; `os-dev.md` L52–L53). Holds — closing loses no finding, only a card.

**Facets, this seat's reading against the card's:** ① same direction, A: one population, one first-touch answer; `triage-duties.md` L79 「三类内无证据拒收」 already leans A on this very population (the review of record corrected the card's two SKILL.md citations: L112 and L284 concern out-of-class cards). ② same: both rules came from a real incident; the cost A pays (a wrong close) is one free reopen, the cost B pays (a hidden defect parked at p3) has no alarm. ③ same: A closes loudly, naming the missing `reach:`; B parks silently. ④ same: no gate, no label; A opens fewer cards, 「没必要的 issue 就不要创建」.

**Recommend A.** 口径 for the ruling: `triage-duties.md` L50 reads, from the ruling on, that a non-exception `finding` with no `reach:` is closed `not_planned` at first touch, the closing line naming the missing item and the collector card when one exists; the p3 fold into a collector card stays for a `finding` that carries `reach:` but sits below the dispatch bar; #20088 item 3's 「⛔ 分诊不因此关卡」 is superseded for that population and no other. Not taken: B — it keeps two first-touch rules alive by narrowing a line the maintainer ruled verbatim three days later.

**Workload of the letter:** skills lane · 1 Tier S text PR, line-neutral at the file's ceiling (120/120) · precedent PR #24602 (+4/−4).

**After the ruling:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:skills`, p2: two live rules on today's triage); the skills seat dispatches; the dev quotes the ruled sentence in the PR body; contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

Ruling: batch #373 item 1 · letter B · maintainer 「24610 B」 2026-10-19T23:47Z

Director seat, summon #45, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i` (GitHub `os-justin`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay, read back), on the skills seat 2's decision card (A recommended by the filer and by this seat's delta 6279612598; the maintainer chose B). Opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6279597228. The maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「24610 B 24646 B 24591 的问题时处理 objectstack 任务的时候经常需要 cloud 权限，这一类的卡片能否直接把 cloud 部分分拆成一个 cloud 车道的卡片。 24525 A」. Thread-read: 6279612598.

**What the ruling binds (letter B — the p3 fold stays; the new line closes only what is none of the four categories):**
1. `triage-duties.md` L50 stands as written: a non-exception `finding` with no `reach:` is graded `priority:p3` and folded into its collector or sweep card, ⛔ not dispatched alone, ⛔ not closed for that reason.
2. `filing-gate.md` L27 narrows to 「四类皆非」: the first-touch close for missing items applies only to a card that is none of the four categories; the clause 「或 `finding` 无 `reach:`」 leaves the line. Line-neutral at the file's ceiling (64/64).
3. The 「B」 of #24589 is re-ruled to exactly that extent; the re-ruling is recorded on #24589 by pointer. #20088 item 3 stands whole.
4. Who closes a reach-less `finding` is unchanged by this ruling: the maintainer, as #20088 item 3 says (「关卡归维护者」).
Not taken: A — the maintainer keeps the two populations apart: an incomplete card is completed and graded, a reach-less finding is parked at p3, and only a card outside the four categories is closed at first touch.

**Workload of the letter:** skills lane · 1 Tier S text PR, one line in `filing-gate.md`, line-neutral · precedent PR #24602 (+4/−4).

**Execution:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:skills`, `priority:p2`); the skills seat dispatches; the dev quotes items 1–2 above in the PR body; contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; the PR's 维护者速读 names #24589 and this ruling.
